brief:
Hundreds of Israelis demonstrated Saturday demanding that opposition parties form a coalition with Arab lawmakers to remove Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from office, Al-Monitor reported. The protesters took to the streets as Netanyahu has intensified attacks against Arab political leaders and their parties.

The call for an opposition-Arab alliance represents a significant shift in Israeli political dynamics, as Arab parties have historically remained outside governing coalitions. Netanyahu's escalating rhetoric toward Arab communities and their representatives has prompted calls from within Israel's protest movement to break traditional political boundaries in pursuit of a change in government.
dek: Hundreds of Israelis took to the streets on Saturday to urge the opposition to ally with Arab parties to oust Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who has gone on the offensive against the minority group's leaders.
title: Israeli protesters call on opposition to ally with Arab parties against Netanyahu
